definitions.explanation: Being younger than others, especially within a group such as a family, class, or team. Often used attributively with の or in compounds.

examples.japanese: {年少|ねんしょう}の{子|こ}ども。
{弟|おとうと}は{私|わたし}より{三|みっ}つ{年少|ねんしょう}だ。
examples.english: My younger brother is three years younger than me.

examples.japanese: チームの{中|なか}で{最|さい}{年少|ねんしょう}の{選手|せんしゅ}が{活躍|かつやく}した。
examples.english: The youngest player on the team performed well.

notes:
USAGE: {年少|ねんしょう} means younger or junior in age, most often used attributively with の or inside compounds. It is the antonym of {年長|ねんちょう}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {年少|ねんしょう}{組|ぐみ}: the younger group (e.g. in kindergarten)
- {年少|ねんしょう}{者|しゃ}: a younger/junior person
- {最|さい}{年少|ねんしょう}: the youngest

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {年下|としした}: younger — the everyday, colloquial word for someone younger
- {年長|ねんちょう}: older, senior — the direct antonym
